fields.label: WLED controller IP address (e.g. 192.168.1.50)
Number of LEDs on the strip (max 490)
Where the strip's first LED sits: LEDs counted clockwise from the screen's top-left corner, seen from the front (0 = it starts at the top-left corner)
Does the strip run counter-clockwise, seen from the front? 0 = no (clockwise), 1 = yes

Optional. Only used while the picture is DRM-protected (e.g. a streaming app): how many spots round the screen edge are measured. 24 is a good default; fewer = each spot updates faster but the colour is coarser (4-73). Leave the default if unsure

apps.description: 10-foot client for your self-hosted TubeArchivist: pair from your phone, never type on the remote. Needs the project's gateway and transcoder containers on your LAN; the gateway URL is written into the package on install.

apps.name: TV Clock
apps.description: Simple clock and screen saver for Samsung Tizen 6.0+ TVs.

apps.name: TV Dashboard
apps.description: A calm remote-first home screen: weather and news as a short letter, an app rack, and an ambient art gallery.

apps.name: TV-Store
apps.description: The Apps2Samsung catalog on the TV itself: browse with the remote and install apps natively through the set's own developer connection, with no PC or phone in the loop after a one-time arming from the Apps2Samsung 3.0 (or newer) toolbox. Needs Developer Mode with the Host PC IP set to the TV's own address.

apps.name: TVapp
apps.description: Enable seamless playback of HLS/m3u8 streams as channels.

apps.name: Twitch Old Tizen
apps.description: Twitch client for older Samsung Tizen TVs (2.4/3.0) with 720p/1080p playback fixes for channels that enable 1440p, plus device-code sign-in.

apps.name: UltimatiumTube
apps.description: Ad-free YouTube for Samsung Tizen 5.0 and 5.5 TVs.

apps.name: UltimatiumTube
apps.description: Ad-free YouTube for Samsung Tizen 5.0 and 5.5 TVs.

apps.name: UniFi Cameras
apps.description: Live camera grid for UniFi Protect or any RTSP cameras on Samsung Tizen 6.0+ TVs, D-pad to go fullscreen. Needs the project's restreamer (ffmpeg and Python) on an always-on LAN host; its address is written into the package on install.

fields.label: Restreamer address (e.g. http://192.168.1.50:8099)

apps.name: VeloVistrix
apps.description: Read-only PhotoPrism viewer for Samsung Tizen 5.0+ TVs, driven by the remote: albums, places, calendar, labels and folders from your own server, with slideshow. Sign in with an app password, or straight in if the server runs in public mode.

apps.name: Velox
apps.description: Fast Plex client: opens in about a second, smooth scrolling, hardware playback. Tested on Tizen 6.0.

apps.name: Velvet TV
apps.description: Big-screen TV client for the Velvet self-hosted music server.

apps.name: Vemm
apps.description: Unofficial Plex-compatible media player for Samsung Tizen TVs with AVPlay playback, Direct Play and server transcoding.

apps.name: Vetro
apps.description: TV management dashboard with root integration: app inventory, controls and diagnostics in your browser. After install, set Developer Mode Host PC IP to 127.0.0.1 and restart.

fields.label: Dashboard port (default 8099; change it if tizen-youtube is installed)

apps.name: VexonTV
apps.description: Live TV player for Samsung Tizen TVs: M3U, Xtream Codes and Stalker portals, provider EPG and a remote-first interface.

apps.name: TVideoPlayer
apps.description: Tizen TV HTML video player based on videojs.

apps.name: Wall
apps.description: Digital photo frame for Samsung Tizen TVs: give it the URL of a ZIP of images, it downloads them and runs a configurable slideshow, with a background service that auto-starts it on boot.

apps.name: Xtream IPTV Player
apps.description: IPTV player for Samsung Tizen TVs with Xtream API support: live TV, movies and series. Bring your own Xtream subscription.

apps.name: YouTube Dummy
apps.description: Lightweight wrapper around youtube.com/tv that injects the TizenTube userscript (ad-free, SponsorBlock), handles remote-control navigation and exits cleanly back to Smart Hub.
